evidence: Labeled P2P and changes AddrMan address selection in src/addrman.cpp and src/net.cpp for GETADDR responses and RPC address retrieval.
rationale: Prevents GETADDR and getnodeaddresses underfill when nodes have large numbers of banned or discouraged peers. While mzumsande notes that returning full address sets prevents peers from inferring banlist size, the issue only manifests under heavy ban or discouragement states and is reasonably deferrable.
